standard: C# and .NET 8 Security Best Practices Guide

forbidden_patterns.reason: FIPS 140-3 / STIG V-222645: MD5 is cryptographically broken and not FIPS-compliant.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Replace with SHA256.Create() or SHA384.Create() for FIPS 140-3 compliance.

forbidden_patterns.reason: FIPS 140-3 / NIST SP 800-131A: SHA-1 is deprecated and not FIPS 140-3 compliant.
FIPS 140-3 / STIG V-222645: DES is cryptographically broken and forbidden by FIPS 140-3.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Replace with AesGcm for authenticated encryption (AES-256-GCM).

forbidden_patterns.reason: FIPS 140-3: 3DES (TDEA) is deprecated by NIST SP 800-131A and should not be used.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Replace with AesGcm (AES-256-GCM) for FIPS 140-3 compliant authenticated encryption.

forbidden_patterns.reason: FIPS 140-3: RC2 is a broken cipher forbidden by FIPS 140-3.
OWASP A03: SQL query constructed via string concatenation is vulnerable to SQL injection.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Use parameterized queries via SqlCommand with SqlParameter: cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", userId), or use EF Core with LINQ.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A03: Process.Start() with string concatenation can enable command injection.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Use ProcessStartInfo with separate FileName and Arguments properties, and validate all inputs before passing to Process.Start.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A02 / NIST SC-8: Bypassing TLS certificate validation enables man-in-the-middle attacks.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Remove the certificate bypass callback. Use proper certificate pinning or ensure valid CA-signed certificates are deployed.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A07 / NIST IA-5: Hardcoded password detected in source code.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Remove hardcoded passwords. Use IConfiguration and environment variables or Azure Key Vault / AWS Secrets Manager.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A07 / NIST IA-5: Hardcoded password in appsettings/config detected.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Remove credentials from appsettings.json. Use Secret Manager, Azure Key Vault, or environment variable injection.

forbidden_patterns.reason: OWASP A08 / Microsoft Security Advisory: BinaryFormatter is unsafe and must not be used for deserialization.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Replace BinaryFormatter with System.Text.Json, XmlSerializer, or another safe serializer. BinaryFormatter is disabled by default in .NET 7+.

forbidden_patterns.reason: FIPS 140-3 / NIST SP 800-90A: System.Random is not cryptographically secure.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Use RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes() or RandomNumberGenerator.GetInt32() (System.Security.Cryptography) for security-sensitive random values.

forbidden_patterns.reason: STIG: Suppressing security-related code analysis warnings (SQL injection, weak crypto, TLS) is not permitted.
forbidden_patterns.remediation: Fix the underlying security issue instead of suppressing the warning. Approved suppressions require documented security review.
